thread:
anya: Heads-up — kickoff for the Autumn Campaign dry-run. Major customer events across NA/EU on Nov weekend. We need a quick readiness check for GPU capacity, regional fallback plans, and a cost guardrail. I started a simulation job (infra-bot kicked it off).

infra-bot: autoscale-dryrun started (job id: ar-2026-11-01). sim window 48h, synthetic QPS profile loaded: customer-events-v2.

sam: Numbers from product: peak concurrent sessions ~6k, avg seq len 420 tokens, expected 18k–30k GPU-hours over the 48h window depending on batching.

mike: Can you confirm per-region split? we need to know if eu-west or apac spikes will force cross-region routing.

anya: Primary load: 70% us-west/us-east, 25% eu-west, 5% ap-southeast. But a single retail partner is EU-heavy and could saturate eu-west.

jia: We saw spot churn last holiday. eu-west spot capacity historically drops 45% during retailer promos. We should pin a fallback model there and enable cross-region spill to us-east if latency delta < 180ms.

ron: Cost quick calc: if baseline is 24k GPU-hours and infra marginal cost $3.1/hr, that's ~$74k raw. With burst on-demand and cross-region egress, add ~12% => ~$83k. If we route to quantized variants for 30% of traffic, we save ~35% on GPU-hours.

sam: Agree. Strategy proposal: 1) pre-warm dedicated pool in eu-west to 40% of expected peak (reduce cold-start tail). 2) allow spill to us-east with traffic-weighted routing. 3) fallback policy to 7B-quant model for non-critical routes. 4) run cache-warm job 6h before traffic.

mike: autoscale sim results are in (summary):
```
- simulated peak nodes: 152 (GPU A100-equivalents)
- average utilization during peak: 62%
- predicted tail latency p95: 420ms with current batching
- with warm_pool=30 nodes pre-warmed: tail p95 -> 330ms
- with 7B-quant fallback enabled for 25% traffic: nodes drop by ~38
```

jia: Good. Can you drop the autoscale policy we used for the sim? I'll vet it vs current production policy.

mike: Yea, used config below:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_nodes: 12
  max_nodes: 220
  warm_pool: 30
  scale_policy: target_utilization
  target_gpu_util: 65
  scale_cooldown_secs: 45
  spot_fallback_threshold: 0.25   # fraction losing spot capacity
  cross_region_spill: true
  spill_latency_budget_ms: 180
```

anya: Two risk items: 1) eu-west spot outage -> need runbook for fast node replacement + alert to product for degraded quality. 2) Cost overrun if fallback to on-demand happens frequently. Suggest putting a hard budget fence that throttles non-critical routes when estimated run rate > budget.

ron: I'll add budget guardrail to billing rules: emergency_throttle=true when projected cost > $95k for campaign window. That will only affect low-priority user segments.

infra-bot: prewarm-job scheduled: prewarm-eu-west-2026-11-20 at T-6h to campaign start. cache-warm job will run with synthetic prefixes (batch size 128).

sam: Action items:
- mike: finalize autoscale policy + upload to infra repo (PR).
- jia: validate eu-west reserved capacity and confirm spot risk numbers with cloud account manager.
- ron: add billing guardrail and telemetry alert for projected cost.
- anya: coordinate product about prioritized route list for fallback.

mike: I'll open PR and link sim logs. Quick note: for the fallback quant model, we should run a small AB on quality metrics; avoid regressions on high-value partners.

anya: yes — schedule AB for the first 6 hours of the campaign for partner A and control traffic 10% -> 30% ramp.

jia: One more ask: if eu-west falls below threshold, can we preemptively shift cache hotkeys to us-east to reduce cold miss penalty? currently cache is region-local. That would add egress but cut tail latency.

mike: Technically doable with short policy change; we'll need a quick migration step in the cache controller. I'll prototype a cross-region hotkey copy with TTL 2h.

ron: Blocker noted: need legal signoff for egress on partner data for EU->US. ops-sre to coordinate with privacy.

anya: Good catch. I'll loop in data-privacy and product. For now mark cross-region spill as conditional on legal OK.

infra-bot: autoscale-dryrun finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-sim/artifacts/ar-2026-11-01/ (logs + node-traces).

sam: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene after PR + legal check. If we can get prewarm + cache warm verified, we should be good to run the campaign with the guardrails. :thumbsup:

mike: ping me if you want the sim dashboard link. I'll paste in channel when PR is up.

anya: End of thread — next sync in 48h or async updates here.
